_metadata.description: Authoritative configuration for Drone Recon Triage Clustering, Rescue Prioritization Index, Escalation Rules, and Routing Cutoffs

weights._comment: Base weights for 4 RPI factors (must sum to 1.0). If any factor is missing, remaining weights re-normalize dynamically.

thresholds._comment: Tier thresholds applied to 0-100 RPI score. Tier is PROVISIONAL if data completeness is below provisional_completeness_threshold.

clustering._comment: Spatial clustering of survivor locks into triage zones using UTM meter projection

population_and_vulnerability._comment: Population count is capped at people_cap. Blended 60% headcount ratio + 40% vulnerable proportion.

structure_damage._comment: Discrete normalized scores per structure condition

flood_severity._comment: Water depth against max depth cap in meters, blended with water trend factor

isolation._comment: Composite of road access cutoffs and inability to self-evacuate

escalation_rules.name: Collapsing Structure with People Present
escalation_rules.reason: Structure is actively collapsing with confirmed trapped occupants.

escalation_rules.name: Rising Water with Non-Evacuable People
escalation_rules.reason: Flood waters are rising rapidly while survivors are unable to self-evacuate.

routing_hazard._comment: Buffer radius in meters around road cutoff marks, penalty multipliers, and expiry

staleness._comment: Observations older than stale_hours are marked STALE with a re-observe recommendation
